best_hook.why: Villainess coldly promises the magistrate will call the heroine's medicine witchcraft; a deadly frame stated outright.

best_cliffhanger.why: Catherine mocks what a penniless veteran could do against Ashbrook; the question hangs, with irony since he is secretly a duke.

must_promos.why: Witchcraft threat, 'I can burn it', corpse at the end of the rope, 'you should have stayed forgotten', 'my husband will find me' and the sneering challenge left unanswered.

standalone_risk: 'It' (the mother's herbarium) is unexplained if the clip starts at the witchcraft line, and a stranger does not know the scarred veteran husband is secretly a duke, so the closing irony is lost.
notes: Dungeon shove and breakdown in scene 3 (S03-B002 to S03-B022) is a usable second cut but its ending is a vow rather than an open threat.
